Done

Done — here's the rebuilt version with all four fixes:

What changed

1. Auto-scroll now actually works The page slowly scrolls on its own (about 14 px/sec) starting a few seconds after the opening lines appear. The moment you touch, swipe, scroll, click, or press a key, it stops permanently and stays where you are. The earlier version used a one-shot animation that could finish instantly — this one moves continuously frame by frame, so it genuinely scrolls.

2. Real finger-rub scratch card The date box now has a true scratch cover drawn on a canvas. Drag your finger (mobile) or mouse (laptop) across it to rub off the lavender coating. Once you've cleared about half of it, the cover fades away and the date + countdown reveal automatically. No button — it's a genuine scratch interaction.

3. Lavender + lilac salvia theme Replaced the pink palette with lavender/lilac tones throughout. The corner decorations are now salvia-style flowering shrubs — tall green stems with clustered purple lilac blooms — drawn in all four corners to match.

4. Intro quote removed + full-page enlarged logo

  • The quote line under the initials is gone — now it's just the title and the initials button.
  • After the opening lines, the logo fills the entire screen (width: 100vw; height: 100vh, contained so nothing crops), sized to fit both mobile and laptop just like your original.

A couple of things worth knowing:

  • The scratch card needs the real image files present when you open it via a server (or Netlify). Opening the raw HTML directly from disk works for the scratch/scroll/animations, but the maps and images load best when deployed.
  • If the auto-scroll speed feels off once you test it, tell me a target (e.g. "should take about 90 seconds top to bottom") and I'll set the exact pixel rate.

One quick check: do you want the logo screen to also auto-advance as part of the slow scroll, or should the scroll pause briefly on the full-page logo before continuing?
